beach.note: Beach records belong in the Places group as swimming.

bay_and_swimming.note: Bay/swimming records belong in the Places group as swimming.

cultural_agricultural.note: Agricultural history is a heritage POI.

harbor_services.note: Harbor-service clusters are marina metadata; the user explicitly agreed to skip them.

nature.note: Natural features become attraction or viewpoint depending on the record.

nature_reserve.note: Nature reserve context is a Places attraction when it is useful to show.

natural_swim_rest.note: Natural swim/rest records should use the swimming icon rather than creating a new type.

poi.note: POIs are mapped by record to heritage, attraction, or viewpoint.

rental.note: Rentals are optional/paid services. Import as service only after an explicit product decision.

public_bathing_place.note: Public bathing places belong in the Places group as swimming.

rest_cultural.note: Rest/cultural hybrid records should use rest-area unless a stronger heritage reading is needed.

route_feature.note: Named route features can be quiet Places attractions without a new icon.

sauna.note: Saunas are optional/paid services. Suppress unless intentionally shown as service.

shelter_fire_rest_area.note: Split into shelter, fire, and rest-area records where the source supports all three.

shop.note: Grocery/resupply shops belong with food; non-food shops can be service or suppressed later.

snorkeling.note: Snorkel-trail records belong with swimming rather than a separate category.

transport.note: Transport records should feed access/connection modeling; only render as transit points when useful.

water_campsite_context.note: Campground/service-context water is not a public trail refill unless separately verified.

access.note: General access point. Do not import as an ordinary facility.

bus_ferry_transfer.note: Potential ferry transfer with a land-transit leg.

connector_access.note: Connector access point for chaining sections.

island_bus_route_metadata.note: Route metadata only; not a map facility.

land_to_ferry_transfer_metadata.note: Transfer metadata for connecting land transit to ferry.

mainland_bus_route_metadata.note: Route metadata only; not a map facility.

mainland_transfer_hub.note: Mainland transfer hub; useful for access display, not a trail facility.

private_transport.note: Private transport is fallback context, not a public trail connection.

public_ferry_quay.note: Public ferry quay; candidate for ferry stop or connection endpoint.

public_ferry_route_metadata.note: Ferry-route metadata for Slice 2 transfer mapping.

rowboat_crossing.note: Self-service rowboat crossing; first-class connection route, not a facility.
